app.title: EasyVoice
app.exit_done: Quit — you can close this page now.
field.lang_info: Language the text will be read in — independent of voice; any voice can read any language
field.voice_info: Determines whose voice it sounds like; can be used across languages
field.text: Enter the text to read aloud
banner.cpu: CPU mode — slower generation; split long text for speed
voice.name: Voice name
preset.name: Preset name
voice.hint: Upload or record ~10 seconds of clear speech to clone; preview it before saving.
style.title: Style
adv.title: Advanced
adv.hint: All values have sensible defaults — skip freely; fine-tune only if needed.
adv.temperature_info: Higher = more varied and expressive but more random; lower = steadier and repeatable. Style already sets this — usually no need to change.
adv.top_p_info: Usually leave as is — Style already sets it.
adv.top_k_info: Usually leave as is — Style already sets it.
adv.rep_pen_info: If the voice repeats, stutters or stalls, raise it a bit (>1); otherwise keep 1.
adv.max_tokens_info: Raise the tier if the ending gets cut off or you need longer audio.
adv.tok_slow: slow to generate — split long text
adv.seed_info: 0 = random each time; a positive integer makes the same settings reproducible
guide.presets: Manage saved presets here: delete unwanted ones. Applying and saving happen on the Dub tab; to rename, re-save there with the new name, then delete the old one.
hero.trust: Runs locally · Free · Your voice never leaves this computer
field.text_ph: Type the text you want spoken…
voice.name_ph: Name this voice so you can pick it later…
err.need_text_voice: Please enter text and select a voice
err.need_ref_audio: Please upload or record reference audio (~10s of clear speech)
voice.manage_hint: ▶ preview · ✎ rename · ↑↓ reorder · 🗑 delete (new recordings go to the top)
voice.empty: No voices yet — add one on the left.
preset.empty: No presets yet. Set things up on the Dub tab and click Save as preset.
tab.subtitle: Subtitle Dub
sub.guide: Three steps: ① upload & parse subtitles ② assign voices and generate line by line ③ assemble & export (optionally into your video).
err.need_subtitle: Please upload a subtitle file first
err.no_cues: No subtitles parsed — check the format (SRT / VTT / LRC)
sub.detect_speakers_info: Splits speakers by prefix; if unsure, turn off — every line uses the default voice (safer when text contains colons).
sub.select_hint: Select a row above to edit
err.no_project: Upload and parse a subtitle file first.
err.nothing_generated: Click "Generate all" to synthesize before exporting.
sub.mux_failed: Video mux failed (ffmpeg missing or errored); audio and subtitles were still exported.
sub.export_skipped: {n} line(s) not generated or not up to date were skipped.
model.title: Quality
model.dl_hint: First use of 1.7B downloads the model (a few GB); it runs automatically when you click generate.
field.text_over: over the current tier (~{m} min) — raise the tier or split the text
